Markets fear a reversal of Nvidia’s aggressive financing for AI startups, while new US congressional bills tighten export controls on advanced chips, triggering extreme volatility in global AI compute supply.

linked_tweets.content_zh:
埃隆，这不是一键就能轻松完成的

付费用户正在实时观看 Grok Bot 的崩溃。即使使用最高的订阅计划，人们在限制重置之前几天就会耗尽使用量

与此同时，机器人每天都变得越来越慢、越来越不智能、越来越不可靠。过去工作完美的事情现在失败了，给出了错误的答案，或者陷入了困境

人们在正常甚至较轻的工作负载下达到 100% 使用率，使得该产品在一周结束之前几乎毫无用处。

您的团队几乎没有提及这些严重的使用和质量问题

Grok Bot 应该是一个可以处理实际工作的人工智能代理。但现在，它在那些相信你的承诺的人面前分崩离析

站起来。修复使用限制，恢复用户最初付费的品质
linked_tweets.content_en:
Elon this is not one-click-easy

Paying users are watching Grok Bot fall apart in real time. People are running out of usage days before their limits reset, even on the highest subscription plans

At the same time, the bots are becoming slower, less intelligent, and less reliable every day. Things that used to work perfectly now fail, give wrong answers, or get stuck

 People are hitting 100% usage with normal or even lighter workloads, making the product almost useless before the week is over.

Your team has said almost nothing about these serious usage and quality problems

Grok Bot is supposed to be an AI agent that can handle real work. But right now, it's falling apart in front of the very people who trusted your promises

Step up. Fix the usage limits and restore the quality users originally paid for

linked_tweets.author: CHIIIDEX 💔💔
linked_tweets.content_zh:
经过充分训练的人工智能模型并不意味着它不再需要计算能力。

训练教会模型如何识别模式、理解语言和生成响应。

但每次有人使用该模型时，它仍然需要计算资源来处理请求并产生答案，这称为推理。

想象一下数百万人同时使用 ChatGPT、生成图像、编写代码和运行 AI 代理。每次交互都需要处理能力。

与训练不同，推理是一个持续的过程。当模型发布时它并没有停止。

这就是人工智能公司继续投资数十亿美元建设数据中心和数千个 GPU 的原因。

构建智能模型是一项挑战。拥有足够的计算能力来服务世界是另一回事。
linked_tweets.content_en:
An AI model being fully trained doesn’t mean it stops needing computing power.

Training teaches the model how to recognize patterns, understand language, and generate responses. 

But every time someone uses that model, it still needs computing resources to process the request and produce an answer., This is called inference.

Think about millions of people using ChatGPT simultaneously, generating images, writing code, and running AI agents. Every interaction requires processing power.

Unlike training, inference is an ongoing process. It doesn’t stop when the model is released.

This is why AI companies continue investing billions in data centers and thousands of GPUs.

Building an intelligent model is one challenge. Having enough computing power to serve the world is another.

topics.category_tag_zh: 旗舰大模型性能与安全治理
topics.title_zh: 阿里发布2.4万亿参数Qwen4-Max模型
topics.title_en: Alibaba Launches 2.4T MoE Model Qwen4-Max Amid Safety Filtering
topics.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴正式推出旗舰MoE大模型Qwen4-Max，拥有2.4万亿参数及100万token窗口。官方强调已通过清洗数据剔除网络攻击及CBRN（核生化放）相关知识，虽在编程基准测试中超越主流竞品且成本显著下降，但其闭源决策与深度数据清洗引发行业关于AI能力边界的博弈。
topics.summary_en: Alibaba unveiled Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter MoE model with a 1M-token context window. While demonstrating superior coding performance and lower costs, Alibaba emphasizes safety by filtering offensive cyber and CBRN capabilities, sparking debate over closed-weight distribution and strict data sanitization.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 阿里巴巴 AI 治理委员会
perspective_pro.point_zh: 坚持技术必须有底线，通过预处理剔除有害知识是构建负责任AI大模型的必由之路，而非单纯追求算力堆叠。
perspective_pro.point_en: Maintaining that technology must have clear bottom lines; pre-processing data to remove harmful knowledge is essential for responsible AI development, rather than chasing raw compute power.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 开源社区与独立安全研究员
perspective_con.point_zh: 质疑通过数据过滤实现安全是“掩耳盗铃”，这种做法并未从根本上增强模型安全性，反而限制了模型的推理广度和泛化能力。
perspective_con.point_en: Arguing that safety through data filtering is a superficial fix; it fails to inherently secure the model while unnecessarily limiting its reasoning breadth and generalization capabilities.

linked_news.title_zh: 阿里巴巴表示，它过滤了 Qwen4-Max 的训练数据，以消除进攻性网络能力并减轻化学、生物、放射性和核风险
linked_news.title_en: Alibaba says it filtered Qwen4-Max's training data to remove offensive cyber capabilities and mitigate chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear risks (Ann Cao/South China Morning Post)

linked_tweets.author: Flames
linked_tweets.content_zh:
告诉人工智能代理它不应该做什么与​​使其在技术上无法做到这一点是不同的。

当人工智能代理处理某人的资金时，这种差异很重要。

您可以告诉代理人避免某些资产、设置支出限额或在出现一定损失后停止交易。但如果它仍然拥有执行交易的广泛权限，那么这些指令就只能到此为止。

通过 MOTES (@meetmotes)，所有者可以设置授权并签署权限。在拟议的交易进行之前，智能账户会根据所有者批准的规则对其进行检查。

因此，代理仍然可以分析市场并制定策略，但它必须在这些限制内运作。它不能只是允许自己在批准的清单之外支出更多资金或交易资产。

我认为这是自主金融更好的基础。赋予代理人做出决策的能力是一回事。确保它仅具有所有者授予的权限也同样重要。
linked_tweets.content_en:
telling an AI agent what it shouldn't do is different from making it technically unable to do it.

when an AI agent is handling someone's money, that difference matters.

you can tell an agent to avoid certain assets, set a spending limit or stop trading after a certain loss. but if it still has broad permission to execute transactions, those instructions only go so far.

with MOTES (@meetmotes), the owner sets the mandate and signs the permissions. before a proposed transaction goes through, the smart account checks it against the rules the owner approved.

so the agent can still analyse the market and come up with strategies, but it has to work within those limits. it can't just give itself permission to spend more or trade assets outside the approved list.

i think this is a better foundation for autonomous finance. giving an agent the ability to make decisions is one thing. making sure it only has the authority the owner gave it is just as important.

topics.title_en: Anthropic Launches IPO Targeting $1.4T Valuation Amid Massive Skepticism
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic启动公开募股，拟募集904亿美元并冲击1.4万亿美元的惊人估值。公司愿景宣称AI将终结癌症等顽疾，但其巨额资金需求与当前昂贵的推理成本、尚未明朗的商业变现路径形成鲜明对比，成为资本市场关于AI泡沫是否存在的最强风向标。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic has launched an IPO seeking up to $90.4B, targeting a $1.4T valuation. While promoting a vision where AI renders diseases as 'relics,' the massive capital requirements versus opaque monetization paths highlight deep-seated market skepticism regarding the sustainability of the AI bubble.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 顶级风险投资人与机构投资者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 认为AI是堪比工业革命的基础设施，当前的估值是对其未来重构人类生物学与生产力逻辑的提前定价。
perspective_pro.point_en: Believing AI is an infrastructure comparable to the Industrial Revolution; current valuations are early pricing for its potential to fundamentally redefine human biology and productivity.

perspective_con.point_zh: 指出百倍于营收的估值已脱离基本面，单纯靠烧钱扩充参数规模无法解决高昂的边际推理成本和极低的单位利润。
perspective_con.point_en: Pointing out that valuation exceeding 100x revenue is detached from fundamentals; burning cash to scale parameters fails to address the crushing marginal costs of inference.

linked_tweets.author: Emmanuel
linked_tweets.content_zh:
让人工智能代理获得资本是一回事。准确定义它可以用这笔资金做什么是另一回事。

这是@meetmotes 架构的重要组成部分。

每个 Motes NFT 都连接到一个专用的智能账户，而所有者则定义管理代理行为的权限和限制。

这在资产托管和自动执行之间形成了明确的分离。

代理人不应该对某人的资金拥有无限的权力。它的行动应该保持在所有者设定的范围内。

对我来说，这是自主金融的一个重要设计考虑因素。

情报很重要，但控制执行也同样重要。

一个 NFT，一个 Agent，有自己的账户和明确的边界
linked_tweets.content_en:
giving an AI Agent access to capital is one thing. Defining exactly what it can do with that capital is another.

That's an important part of the @meetmotes architecture.

Every Motes NFT is connected to a dedicated smart account,while the owner defines the permissions and limits that govern the agent's actions.

This creates a clear separation between asset custody and automated execution.

The agent isn't supposed to have unlimited authority over someone's funds. Its actions are meant to stay within the boundaries established by the owner.

For me, this is a crucial design consideration for autonomous finance.

Intelligence matters,but controlled execution matters just as much.

One NFT, one Agent, with its own account and defined boundaries
